disposition_reason: Prints range and mean ± SD of nickel, manganese, cadmium, copper, zinc, lead and chromium in locally made and imported noodles, spaghetti and macaroni sold in Nigeria.

study.design: market survey of 60 pasta packets, locally produced vs imported, three pasta types
study.origin: locally manufactured in Nigeria, or imported from Turkey, Thailand, France and Italy
study.method: flame AAS (Agilent 240FS) after HNO3/HClO4 (1:1) digestion of 2 g ground pasta to 50 mL
lod: LOD/LOQ printed in µg/mL of solution (Table 1), e.g., Pb 0.004/0.048, Cd 0.002/0.027, Cr 0.02/0.042, Mn 0.01/0.032; table layout partly garbled for Zn, Ni, Cu
study.qa: spike recoveries 91 to 108% (means 92.0 to 98.7%); reagent blanks; no CRM
